name: 63138 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63138 (Saint Louis) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63138 (Saint Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63138 (Saint Louis) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
